gauntlet: question
Reusing the resolver fits because `settings/resolver.ts:12` already owns defaults, and `ui/report-view.ts:30` already consumes its resolved settings. Adding the setting there preserves one source of truth; a view-local settings object would introduce a second ownership path for the same view.

With that ownership settled, what should the new setting’s default behavior be when switching workspaces?
A) reset report filters — filters from the previous workspace no longer hide rows.
B) preserve report filters — keep today’s behavior unless the user enables resetting.
C) other — name the desired behavior.
Recommendation: A - it addresses the hidden-row problem by default while letting users choose preservation.
